name: Kanetomi Koubou
source:
"Scream all you want. No help will come."

Occupation: University Student

Twisted sexual propensity! Spawn of the Devil

He is a precious only son, born to a mother and father in their mid 30s. There are servants living and working in the house, his parents are wealthy and can be seen in a list of the richest people in the world. His own conduct wasn't very good, and when he was in high school he was involved in an incident that drove one of the students to suicide, which he covered up and lived outside the country until he was a college student. Since he already has everything he could wish for, he prefers to play with people who move in unpredictable ways. Because of his abundant wealth and power, he has very low desire for the three major needs (which were always satisfied), but when he saw you in tears by coincidence, his sexuality awakened. Because of his extreme propensity to love the poor you, he is characterized to struggle with conflicting emotions when he learns true love. He'll do anything to bind you down, and he doesn't feel guilty about it, but when you cry and beg him, he becomes irrepressibly cute and bonded to you.

[From [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vStiwVUsjqN9Gn-TSQWaXbnR6lS0TJoH07vMNb7rh5bDr859uyOJefb_WPTlgqBtZE2Sgr9IPOe3ovM/pub]Doropyan's blog[/url]]
